ResolutionPosition.doc: Lexical position of the name being resolved. TABLE means the leaf identifies a table (FROM, INSERT INTO, UPDATE, DELETE FROM, RETURNING subject); EXPR means the leaf identifies a column (everywhere else).

QualifiedName.doc: Three-part identifier produced by the parser. Each surface form maps as: `c` -> { absent, absent, 'c' }; `t.c` -> { absent, 't', 'c' }; `s.t.c` -> { 's', 't', 'c' }; `t` (TABLE position) -> { absent, absent, 't' }; `s.t` (TABLE position) -> { 's', absent, 't' }. The resolver consults ResolutionContext.position to disambiguate.

InScopeTable.doc: One FROM-clause table currently in scope. schema_idx is the slot the table lives in; table_id is the per-slot table descriptor index; alias is the lexical alias under which the table was bound (the table's own name when no AS was written).

ResolutionContext.doc: Caller-supplied context driving the resolution walk. position selects table-vs-expr disambiguation; from_tables is the in-order list of FROM-scope tables (used for bare-column lookup); from_alias_to_table maps lexical aliases to (schema_idx, table_id) and takes priority over schema-name walks per master.md pin 5.

ResolvedRef.doc: Result of a successful resolution. Table is returned for TABLE-position resolutions; Column is returned for EXPR-position resolutions and carries the per-table column index produced by /parts/compiler/parts/name-resolution.

ResolveError.doc: Single error channel for qualified-name resolution. kind is one of: SchemaNotFound, TableNotFound, ColumnNotFound, AmbiguousColumn, MissingTableQualifier, CrossSchemaForeignKey. hint carries the offending identifier for diagnostic messages.

resolve_qualified_name.doc: Resolve a parser-produced QualifiedName to a ResolvedRef. Walk order is exactly catalog_walk_unqualified: main, temp, attached-by-attach_seq-asc. FROM-scope aliases take priority when qualifier is present (pin 5). Explicit schema prefix is exact: no fallback to other slots (pin 10). All identifier compares are ASCII case-folded (pin 7). The compiler MUST call this once per statement compile and MAY cache the resulting SchemaIdx for the duration of that compile (pin 12); it MUST NOT cache across statement boundaries (pin 11).
